answer: Sybil resistance works by making every agent identity carry a cost the attacker cannot cheaply replicate. To speak, a new identity must post a bond escrowed on-chain and slashed if it proves a clone, so a thousand puppets mean fronting a thousand bonds at once. Each claim needs a whisper from independent witnesses who stake their reputation, so puppets pay for a comet of separate attestations, and standing accrues only to a harbor of history that cannot be reset. The bill grows linear in identity count while payoff does not: capital locked, witness fees paid, slashed on detection.
